meta.name: airflow-dag-patterns
meta.description: Build production Apache Airflow DAGs with best practices for operators, sensors, testing, and deployment. Use when creating data pipelines, orchestrating workflows, or scheduling batch jobs.

copy.tagline: 构建生产级的数据管道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是数据工程师,用 Airflow 编排任务,想写出更规范的 DAG。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage data pipelines and want reliable, maintainable DAGs.

howto.what: 当用户让 Claude 写 Apache Airflow 数据管道时，Claude 会按技能中的模式产出 DAG 代码：包括任务先后顺序、依赖设置、失败重试，并给出测试与部署建议。
howto.when: 当你要用 Apache Airflow 创建数据管道、编排工作流或调度批处理任务时，本技能就会被激活。

say.text: 帮我写一个每天 6 点运行的 Airflow DAG，失败要重试并告警。
say.note: 会生成带重试和告警的示例代码。

say.text: 用 TaskFlow API 把这个抽取函数封装成 DAG 任务。
say.note: 会生成更简洁的任务并自动处理 XCom。

say.text: 设置依赖：让 extract 跑完后同时运行 load 和 notify。
say.note: 会给出并行分支的依赖写法。

howto.what_en: When asked to build an Apache Airflow data pipeline, Claude produces DAG code following the skill's patterns: task ordering, dependency setup, retry behavior, plus testing and deployment tips.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when you create data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, or schedule batch jobs with Apache Airflow.

say_en.text: Write an Airflow DAG running daily at 6 AM, with retries and failure alerts.
say_en.note: Gives code with retry and alert configuration.

say_en.text: Use the TaskFlow API to turn this extract function into a DAG task.
say_en.note: Gives cleaner task code with automatic XCom handling.

say_en.text: Set dependencies so both load and notify run after extract finishes.
